scripts.openapi:export: poetry run python -c "import json; from artiq_http.api import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi()))" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^Production mode' > fern/openapi/openapi.json
scripts.sdk:update: npm run openapi:export && npm run sdk:generate
scripts.plugin:version:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const packageJson=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const pluginPath='.claude-plugin/plugin.json'; const pluginJson=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pluginPath,'utf8')); pluginJson.version=packageJson.version; fs.writeFileSync(pluginPath, JSON.stringify(pluginJson, null, 2) + '\\n'); console.log('Synced plugin version to', packageJson.version);"
scripts.static:update: (rm -r artiq_http/static || true) && cd frontend && npm run build && mv dist ../artiq_http/static
